subject.title: Session `status` field values ("failed", "timeout", "done") mislead agents into spawning duplicate sessions

question: Should OpenClaw fix this by adding additive `resumable`/status-semantics metadata, narrowing the hint to agent tools only, or renaming/redefining the shipped status values?
rationale: The source-repro is clear, but the fix changes a model-visible session contract and needs maintainer intent for `killed`, future statuses, and whether the shared Gateway row should grow.

options.title: Add additive resumability metadata
options.body: Expose a backward-compatible `resumable` signal and model-facing guidance while preserving existing status values.

options.title: Keep the hint agent-tool-only
options.body: Teach `sessions_list` output/prompt text without adding a shared Gateway/client row field.

options.title: Redefine status values
options.body: Rename or split lifecycle statuses with an explicit compatibility and migration plan.

recommendation.title: Add additive resumability metadata
recommendation.body: Expose a backward-compatible `resumable` signal and model-facing guidance while preserving existing status values.

likelyOwner.reason: The session-list status/timing commits make this person the strongest feature-history routing candidate for the model-visible row contract.
